description:
Decision by Joe 2026-07-16: write the generator (StarRocks tuned currently
renders nothing; capability registry honestly says rendered_via: none).

Implement benchbox/core/tuning/generators/starrocks.py per the StarRocks
physical surface (PARTITION BY range/expr, DISTRIBUTED BY HASH(cols) BUCKETS n,
duplicate-key ORDER BY), register it in get_ddl_generator, flip the capability
registry entries from none to ddl, and migrate the StarRocks adapter schema
path to consume the generator following the #1180 pattern (dry-run preview and
execution share the renderer; engine-mandatory DISTRIBUTED BY fallback stays
for untuned tables). Applied-ledger instrumentation for the rendered DDL.

anti_patterns.why: the generator is the single renderer

preserves.behavior: Engine-mandatory DISTRIBUTED BY HASH injection for untuned tables (baseline behavior unchanged)
